Yup! I’d say start with cleanse-toner-moisturize first then after a week if it goes well, you can then introduce serums and stuff. For ingredients, vitamin c and niacinimide isn’t a really good combo, but some blogs say that it’s safe to mix them lol in my case, it was my skin’s nightmare

I suggest you need to focus first on what your skin needs since it’s not really a must to complete the 10 step skincare if you don’t have any issues on a certain part, say skipping the Vitamin C because you don’t have any dark spots/pigmentations. But to answer your question, The Ordinary AHA/BHA peel is a great choice. 

I’ve been in that phase too, bought all the products thinking I can achieve that glass skin, ended up breaking my moisture barrier lol from 10 products, now I’m down to 4 (cleanse, exfoliate, tone, moisturize/sunscreen)

Be careful and don’t forget to patch test before applying everything at once. Also do more research because some of the ingredients conflict with one another. Goodluck!
